notes.title: POLY 0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys, a massive update just dropped for poly!

A lot of OP items and abilities just launched into the game and I'm excited to see what runs people craft with these additions!

Additions Including :
 - Ultimate abilities :
       - A Massive Death Laser
       - Fire rate Boosters
      - A Lightning Zap

- A Electrician Minion
- Bottle Opener Item : You'll See :P
- Minion Buffers
- Foil Variants Of Cards Which Have Doubled/Upgraded Effects

I also made the game a lot more visually appealing with BRAND new particle effect upgrades

Happy Fighting
- Joe

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]POLY 0.4 Update + Controller Support[/h1]

Happy Holidays Folks!, hope everyones having a wonderful end to 2023 and what a great way to spend this time by playing Poly!

[h2] Controller Support Is Here! [/h2]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Complete Controller Support
[*] Added New Enemy : The PentaSniper
[*] Added New Item : Devolve
[*] Added New Gambling Item : Possibly Spoiled Milk
[/list]

[h2]Fixes + Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ricochet is no longer frame rate dependent
[*] Fixed Game Not Loading On First Creating New Settings Files
[*] Fixed Save Data Overriding On New Game Updates
[*] Fixed Enlarged Cursor On Mac Devices
[/list]


+ More stuff, It probable forgot about some extra stuff, didn't keep as good track this time as I did last time :D

Thank You All For Being Patient. Controller Support Took Longer Than Expected :D

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]POLY 0.3 Update + Mac Support Rollout[/h1]

[h2] MAC Support Comes To Poly! [/h2]
over the past week, I have been testing the mac support of the game to make sure that the rollout on mac devices is as smooth as it was for windows! :D, I had a few last minute issues for Mac Support working but hopefully its all fixed now, don't be afraid to join the discord and let me know if there's still issues :D

and after this week I am happy to announce that mac support is coming to poly as of today!

Also I have been working on a ton of new content for the game :P

NEW CHARACTER! Meet the electrician, he zaps enemies with his tesla coil and arcs electricity between them!

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Flawless Achievement, unlocks new item
[*] Added Revitalize Item
[*] Added Lots Of Friends Item
[*] Added Pre And Post Round Informational Flash Text
[*] Added Arc Shot Item (New Bullet Behavior)
[*] Certain Items Stacks In Unique Ways
[*] Grenadier Grenades Now Damage Enemies On Hit, Triggering Items On Hit Effects 
[*] Added Burning Rubber Item
[*] Added How To Play Before Each Game
[*] Added Difficulty Colors For EVERY Difficulty Not Just The First And Last One
[*] Added A List Of Previous Runs Played In The Stats Menu
[/list]

[h2]Fixes + Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bloodlust now works as Intended, 55% chance at luck 100 to increase max health by 1 on enemy kill
[*] Fixed Settings Screen Options Having Multiple Options For Each Resolution
[*] Fixed Poison Field Not Triggering The OnEnemyDamaged Effect On Items
[*] Fixed Correct Spelling Of Death Messages
[*] Fixed Alignment Of Text On Game Over Screen
[*] Fixed Stats Menu Showing Total Of All Players Enemy Kill Count Instead Of The Local Players'
[*] Changed Character Selection To Carousel Instead Of Clamp
[*] Changed Items Descriptions To Be More Specific
[*] Changed Four Leaf Clover To Increase Luck By 2 Instead Of 0.5
[*] Increase Based Speed Of All Characters

[*] Poison Field Becomes Larger The More Poison Fields Your Character Holds
[*] Arc Shot Arcs Between More Enemies The More Arc Shots Your Character Holds
[*] Bloodlust Increases Max Health By A Larger Amount The More Bloodlusts you Hold
[/list]


[h3]Links[/h3]
[list]
[*] Join The Discord To Get Involved : https://discord.gg/TVTkzBwkjX
[/list]
